repeatable_checks.expected: Timetable days and eight selected-class fields fit their containers; no whole-document horizontal overflow; exam terms and unknown time/place remain explicit.

repeatable_checks.trigger: Open module and recognition disclosures; toggle failed-only and select a module.
repeatable_checks.expected: Disclosures remain open, original hierarchy/values stay intact, course filtering stays local.

boundaries.school_reads: existing authorized profile/audit/major/current-term grades/timetable/exams/enrollment preview, for layout verification

association_followup.user_feedback: All queried rows looked unlinked after layout changes; preceding visual acceptance failed.

observed_trigger.grade_course_code: not supplied as an independent field

association_followup.root_cause: UI conflated an unread audit source with a failed cross-source association; supplements were mixed into the same list as audit courses.
changes: Separate unread, failed and acquired-but-unmatched audit states.
Disable audit-status filtering until a usable audit exists.
Offer explicit audit read without adding automatic source requests.
Keep audit groups and unassociated supplemental records in separate tables.
Label term selection as supplemental grade scope.
association_followup.repeatable_check: In a fresh authenticated page, supplement one allowed semester of grades before reading audit. Verify unread labels and disabled audit-status filter. Explicitly read audit; verify original source statuses in the main table and unmatched grade records in a separate supplemental table. Never merge solely by course name.

five_page_split.user_choice: Five independent pages, including separate timetable and exams.
five_page_split.replaces: Combined academic/arrangements workspaces and unmatched-supplement tables.

source_rules.cultivation: graduation_audit only; profile and curriculum PDF auxiliary
source_rules.grades: one selected operation and term; no audit columns
source_rules.timetable: selected combined semester only; no implicit exam reads
source_rules.exams: one selected sub-semester; exact links to already loaded timetable only
source_rules.enrollment: official current scope, independent of historical page queries

repeatable_checks.trigger: Read semester grades; read audit and major data; return to the selected semester.
repeatable_checks.expected: Only that semester grade source is displayed; audit status/module and other cached sources never appear in the grade table.

repeatable_checks.trigger: Select different grade, timetable and exam semesters; navigate away and back.
repeatable_checks.expected: Each page keeps its own query range; an unread range has an empty state, not stale records from another range.

repeatable_checks.trigger: Read timetable and one matching exam term; click uniquely matched exam.
repeatable_checks.expected: Navigation opens the corresponding timetable term and course detail using the validated selection identifier; ambiguous matches remain unlinked.

repeatable_checks.trigger: Expand a grade record in a narrow desktop view.
repeatable_checks.expected: Course and numeric fields remain aligned; selection identifier wraps inside the course column; no whole-page overflow.
